title: White Space Map
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of white-space-mapper. Maps under-explored regions in the surveyed landscape. Only regions that ARE holes are emitted as items — a fully covered landscape yields an empty regions array. Each region carries hole:true so it is a direct classify_gap signal that maps to (coverage_gap, WHITESPACE). Never emit hole:false regions (they are not gaps). Every present item carries at least one non-blank evidence_ref (anti-slop).

regions.description: Under-explored regions (holes) in the literature landscape. Only emit a region when it IS a hole (hole:true). An empty array means the landscape has no identifiable white space.

region.description: Description of the under-explored area. Non-blank required.

hole.description: Always true for an emitted region — signals classify_gap rule 4 (coverage_gap / WHITESPACE). Structurally const:true so a hole:false region (which would match no classify_gap rule and raise) can never be emitted; a covered landscape yields an empty regions array instead.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers grounding this region (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.

density.description: Optional descriptor of coverage density around this region (e.g. 'sparse', 'absent').
